notes.title: More patches
notes.content:
- Fixed overall controller problems when playing with keyboard and mouse.
- Fixed bug where the player cant use any controls at the start of a stage.
- Fixed aura slash problems with pressing and releasing it, UI for the multiplier on it, and speed.
- Fixed rare double dodge stuck in slow motion bug.
- Fixed pausing on levels 3 and up.
- Also more sword skills are mapped to keyboard controls!

notes.title: MAJOR COMBAT UPDATE + INVENTORY
notes.content:
New Directional Attack combos
Lunge punch forward north face button
Short uppercut backwards north face button
Rapid stabbing forward west face button
Heavy slam attack backward west face button
New Hold hits
You can hold the north face button or the west face button for two additional ways to attack
New delay attack combo on the north face button if you wait half a second before pressing it again
New inventory system for saving and swapping between passives you buy while playing through the game.
You can also store and stack multiple of each type.
Dodging has been smoothed and given Iframes.
Controls for dodging have been made more clear.
Camera has been given a slight delay before updating its position.
